_meta.note: PDF catalog for the Telegram Mini App. The Mini App fetches this file; the Cloudflare Worker keeps an inlined copy (worker.js PDF_CATALOG) — keep the two in sync on every change (same ids, same prices, same categories). PRICES (Angela, 2026-11-09 19:04): cap 1-10 Stars and 1-10 ZERO for now; raise later if she says so. test-pdf 1/1, shopping-guide 5/5, safe-shopping-guide 10/10, ai-earning-guide 10/10, store-guide free; all 11 AI tutorials 10/10. ZERO prices are provisional economy units (ZERO market price ~$0). CATEGORIES (2026-11-09): টেস্ট / কেনাকাটা / AI টিউটোরিয়াল / ধর্মীয় বই. Tutorials have preview_url + preview_url_en (public preview PDFs on GitHub Pages). Religion PDFs are reward_only: NOT buyable with Stars/ZERO — free ONLY for daily/weekly/monthly top-3 performers (see worker GET /religion). Religion Books Plan sheet tracks the gradual Quran/Bible/Gita series (25 items). Commercial batch 2026-11-09 (15 titles, all 10/10): 4 more AI টিউটোরিয়াল (prompt library, freelancing, product photos, video workflow) + অনলাইন আয় (3) + ক্যারিয়ার (3) + ভাষা ও পড়াশোনা (3) + স্বাস্থ্য (2, medical disclaimer on every page). CATEGORIES now: টেস্ট / কেনাকাটা / AI টিউটোরিয়াল / অনলাইন আয় / ক্যারিয়ার / ভাষা ও পড়াশোনা / স্বাস্থ্য / ধর্মীয় বই.

schema.description: one-line description shown on the card
schema.file_id: Telegram file_id of the paid PDF. null until Angela sends the real PDF to @BazarGooBot with caption 'pdf:<id>' — the worker stores it in KV. Never put a real file_id in this file by hand.
schema.file_url: free PDFs only: relative URL of the file served from GitHub Pages (e.g. 'payments/files/guide.pdf'). Paid PDFs are delivered by the bot, never from a public URL.
schema.free: true = free download, no payment; false = paid
schema.id: stable slug, used in deep links t.me/BazarGooBot?start=buy_<id> and zero_<id>
schema.price_stars: Telegram Stars price (integer). null = not priced yet. Test PDF = 1 Star only.
schema.price_zero: ZERO coin amount (number, e.g. 100). null = not priced in ZERO yet.
schema.source_file: repo path of the PDF source file (for the admin to send to @BazarGooBot). null when no file exists yet.
schema.title: display title (Bengali/English as shown in the app)
schema.en: true = an English version exists (paid: bot delivers both versions; free: see file_url_en)
schema.file_url_en: free PDFs only: relative URL of the English version on GitHub Pages.
schema.category: group shown in the app library: টেস্ট / কেনাকাটা / AI টিউটোরিয়াল / অনলাইন আয় / ক্যারিয়ার / ভাষা ও পড়াশোনা / স্বাস্থ্য / ধর্মীয় বই
schema.preview_url: public preview PDF on GitHub Pages (tutorials only)
schema.preview_url_en: public English preview PDF on GitHub Pages (tutorials only)
schema.reward_only: true = NOT buyable; free only for top-3 rank holders via the worker
